fusions.name: Encircling Hug
fusions.desc: Closes your arms on every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 11 damage and leaving each [Stunned] for 1 second.

fusions.name: Back to the Bars
fusions.desc: A swipe that deals 5 damage and leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every tenth of your health already lost, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Jaw Snare
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to set a spring snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 20 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 20 damage and is [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bars for Ribs
fusions.desc: Conjures barred plating over your hide: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 8%, your maximum health rises by 8, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
